description: FORMAT EXAMPLE ONLY. cases[]: id; kind "sigma" or "yara" with text (one rule file) and expect (exact list of finding ids from rules.json of the package, SEC-001 excluded), or kind "convert" with text (a Sigma rule) and expect {spl|kql|lucene: exact expected query, or {"error": "text the error must mention"}}, optional fieldmap {target: {SigmaField: TargetField}}. Write and label the rules yourself; do not use SigmaHQ rules (DRL 1.1) unless the owner decides so.

cases.text:
title: Example
logsource:
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith: '\x.exe'
    condition: selection and not filter

rule Example
{
    strings:
        $a = "abcdef"
    condition:
        filesize < 1MB and $a
}

title: Example
logsource:
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        CommandLine|contains: 'abc'
    condition: selection
